messages:
Maya - sales: Hey folks — Presales POC with HelioBank. They report streaming cutouts around 13-16s via their perimeter proxy. Happens from both TS and Python SDKs. Need quick triage.

Owen - solutions: Do we have exact SDK versions and any sample error text?

Maya - sales: TS v1.4.2, Python v1.4.2. They pasted this from browser client: `Error: socket hang up` and python shows `ChunkedEncodingError: ('Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)',)`.

Priya - eng: That pattern smells like an intermediate device tearing long-lived HTTP/2 streams. On our end the request id `hb-22c4` shows tokens emitted for 2+ minutes. No server-side abort.

Marco - infra: Confirmed — server logs show continuous send for that req-id. Likely proxy idle timeout or ALPN/TLS inspection rewriting handshake.

Owen - solutions: Quick repro steps for them: 1) run two curl tests (http2 and forced http1.1) 2) capture `openssl s_client -alpn h2 -connect api.redwood.ai:443` to verify ALPN.

Maya - sales: Sent curl examples. They ran `curl --http2` and it closed ~15s. `curl --http1.1 --no-keepalive` stayed open.

Priya - eng: Workaround: force HTTP/1.1 for the client. TS SDK env flag `REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1=1` or set `preferHttp1: true` in new client config. Python: `REDWOOD_HTTP_VERSION=1`. Also bump client keepalive: `streamingKeepaliveMs` or socket/read timeout to 60s. Example TS snippet: 
```js
process.env.REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1 = '1';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, streamingKeepaliveMs: 60000 });
```
This will use chunked transfer over http/1.1 which most proxies handle better.

Marco - infra: I'll add an internal note to mark spans that are long-lived with header `x-rw-stream: 1` to speed up support lookups. Opening infra ticket.

Owen - solutions: Also document a security FAQ line: we use provider-default TLS stacks (1.2/1.3) and no custom TLS fingerprinting. Priya can we get a short sentence we can paste into security questionnaires?

Priya - eng: Yes: "Redwood terminates TLS using standard cloud-provider stacks (TLS 1.2/1.3) and does not employ custom TLS fingerprinting or non-standard cipher suites for client connections." Feel free to paste.

Maya - sales: HelioBank accepted the http1.1 workaround for POC. They asked about production advice.

Priya - eng: For production behind corporate middleboxes we recommend Dedicated or Private with direct egress or a short-term Dedicated trial so traffic avoids their MITM agent. We'll offer to validate on a trial.

doc-bot: KB created: presales/poc-helio-tls-inspect-h1-workaround  add note to onboarding flow.

Marco - infra: On-call guidance: if you see repeated `RST_STREAM` + client ECONNRESET within 10-20s and server continued output, suggest preferHttp1 and ask for ALPN debug from the customer.

Owen - solutions: Thanks all, I will send step-by-step email (curl + env vars + FAQ snippet) and propose a 7-day Dedicated eval. Close the swarm unless they reopen. :thumbsup:
